keywordGroups.name: Insect biology & behaviour
keywordGroups.usefulness: Retain as a specialist search. Confirm the research or practical duties and the experience required in the complete advert.

keywordGroups.name: Crop protection & IPM
keywordGroups.usefulness: High priority. IPM plus horticulture, technical advisor, plant health or crop trials finds commercial and laboratory routes missed by entomology alone. Broad agronomy roles need a skills check.

keywordGroups.name: Biological control
keywordGroups.usefulness: High priority when combined with insects, crops, horticulture or plant pathogens. Biological control by itself can return unrelated engineering or biomedical roles.

keywordGroups.name: Ecology & conservation
keywordGroups.usefulness: Include substantive species and habitat surveys, UKHab, botanical identification and biodiversity assessment. Biological Recording roles need not involve insects. Broad biodiversity matches can be flagged through Report advert; exclude generic sustainability administration and fundraising.

keywordGroups.name: Pollination & beneficial insects
keywordGroups.usefulness: Retain as a specialist search. Confirm the research or practical duties and the experience required in the complete advert.

keywordGroups.name: Taxonomy & biodiversity recording
keywordGroups.usefulness: Core Biological Recording coverage across insects, plants, fungi and other wildlife. Seek identification, specimen curation, records validation or biodiversity data duties. Records-centre and volunteer roles can build practical experience; check the survey season.

keywordGroups.name: Vectors & veterinary entomology
keywordGroups.usefulness: Retain as a specialist search. Confirm the research or practical duties and the experience required in the complete advert.

keywordGroups.name: Monitoring & environmental risk
keywordGroups.usefulness: Useful for ecological and crop research, species monitoring and biodiversity data. GIS, data and monitoring alone are too broad: require a biological context. Molecular projects need close checks of laboratory skills and degree requirements.

screening.notes: Keywords define the subject scope. Clear relevance matches publish automatically; context matches await an admin decision. Categories are inferred from source metadata. Report links remain available for public adverts.
screening.excludedTitleNotes: Apply these patterns to titles only, before relevance scoring. They exclude non-subject HR/fundraising/governance posts, internal-only calls, research administration and generic degree-application notices. They intentionally retain research technicians, scientific project managers, public engagement, biological-recording and topic-specific self-funded projects for automatic subject matching.

publication.notes: Direct relevance matches publish automatically. Unsure/context matches wait for an authorised decision in the signed-in admin portal. Missing pay, eligibility, country or closing date alone does not require approval.
